[short] skip 'runs bolero build'

# We're testing cache behavior, so start with a clean BOLERO_CACHE.
env BOLERO_CACHE=$WORK/cache

# Build something so that the cache gets populates
bolero build main.go

# Check that cache contains directories before running
exists $BOLERO_CACHE/00

# Run bolero clean -cache -n and ensure that directories weren't deleted
bolero clean -cache -n
exists $BOLERO_CACHE/00

# Re-run bolero clean cache without the -n flag go ensure that directories were properly removed
bolero clean -cache
! exists $BOLERO_CACHE/00

! bolero clean -cache .
stderr 'bolero: clean -cache cannot be used with package arguments'

# BOLERO_CACHE must be an absolute path.
env BOLERO_CACHE=.
! bolero clean -cache
stderr 'bolero: BOLERO_CACHE is not an absolute path'

-- main.go --
package main

import "fmt"

func main() {
	fmt.Println("hello!")
}
